paper.title_en: Optical appearance of regularized compact objects without an exterior photon sphere
paper.abstract_en: Recent observations by the Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) indicate that the shadow of the compact object at our Galaxy's center (Sgr A*) closely resembles that of a Schwarzschild black hole. However, identifying the presence and exact location of unstable circular null geodesics outside the compact object (hereafter referred to as an exterior exterior photon sphere) observationally remains challenging. Motivated by this, we investigate shadow formation in spacetimes that lack an exterior photon sphere by applying the Simpson--Visser (SV) regularization technique (originally designed to smooth black hole singularities) to null singularity and charged null singularity metrics. Apart from the shadow-like dark region without an exterior photon sphere in the charged SV spacetime, our investigation shows that, for a specific range of parameters, the shadow boundary (dark region) is controlled by the regular core rather than by an exterior photon sphere. Our results reveal that shadows arising from these regularized null singularity spacetimes closely mimic those of Schwarzschild and charged black-bounce spacetimes, even though no exterior exterior photon sphere exists. We also perform a phenomenological comparison of the predicted shadow sizes with the EHT observations of Sgr A* and M87, identifying parameter ranges compatible with the observed angular diameters.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究了缺乏外部光子球的规则致密天体的光学外观，并与EHT观测比较，选题新颖且方法严谨。
decision.title_zh: 没有外部光子球的规则化致密天体的光学外观
decision.abstract_zh: 事件视界望远镜（EHT）的最新观测表明，我们银河系中心致密天体（Sgr A*）的阴影与史瓦西黑洞的阴影极为相似。然而，从观测上识别致密天体外部不稳定圆形零测地线（以下简称外部光子球）的存在及其确切位置仍然具有挑战性。受此启发，我们通过将Simpson–Visser（SV）正则化技术（最初设计用于平滑黑洞奇点）应用于零奇点和带电零奇点度规，研究了缺乏外部光子球时空中的阴影形成。除了带电SV时空中没有外部光子球的类阴影暗区外，我们的研究表明，对于特定参数范围，阴影边界（暗区）由规则核心而非外部光子球控制。我们的结果表明，来自这些正则化零奇点时空的阴影与史瓦西和带电黑洞反弹时空的阴影非常相似，即使不存在外部光子球。我们还对预测的阴影大小与Sgr A*和M87的EHT观测进行了现象学比较，确定了与观测角直径一致的参数范围。
